title: accept() partial floor-write failure leaves cache behind disk state
description: Found by robustness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml. Pre-existing, safe direction: if write(state) succeeds and write(floor) fails in accept (announce_store.rs:312-313), accept returns Err(Io) and the in-memory cache keeps the older floor while disk state advanced; a replay of the already-accepted announce can then be re-accepted in-process via the cache hit (:301-307) with the stale lower floor. Never permits durable rollback (disk heals forward on next load), but it is the one cache/disk divergence the heal design permits. Fix: document the divergence in the accept() doc comment, or on floor-write Io failure re-read disk and refresh the cache entry.
